definition_zh: 夸夸其谈；高调浮夸的言辞；大话
definition_en: impressive but meaningless language; inflated talk
core_image: 讲台上唾沫横飞却毫无内容的演讲者
scene: 演讲者挥舞手臂讲了半小时，台下没人记得一句话。The speech was pure bombast with no plan at all.
sceneCN: 这里 bombast 是「夸夸其谈」（第 1 个义项：空洞浮夸的高调言辞）；句意是这篇讲话全是空话，毫无计划可言。

derivatives.zh: bombast 加 -ic，义为「夸夸其谈的；浮夸的」

senses.title: Inflated, empty language
senses.definition: speech that sounds grand but says nothing
senses.definitionCN: 听来堂皇却无实际内容的言辞
senses.example: The speech was pure bombast with no plan at all.
senses.exampleCN: 这篇讲话全是空话，毫无计划可言。
senses.why: Old bombast was cotton padding that swelled a garment; speech that swells without body keeps the name.
senses.whyCN: 旧义 bombast 是撑起衣形的棉絮填料，膨胀而无实体的言辞沿用其名。

senses.title: Grandiose heroic posing in drama
senses.definition: the swaggering grandiloquence of stage heroes and ranters
senses.definitionCN: 舞台上英雄人物虚张声势的豪言
senses.example: The tragic hero strutted through lines of pure bombast.
senses.exampleCN: 悲剧英雄念着满纸空话趾高气扬。
senses.why: Elizabethan rant earned the padded-cloth nickname for its puffery.
senses.whyCN: 伊丽莎白时代的大话式台词因「虚胀」而得了这填料之名。

senses.title: Political and military boasting
senses.definition: boastful official language meant to impress rather than inform
senses.definitionCN: 旨在唬人而非告知的官方豪言
senses.example: The regime answered sanctions with bombast about victory.
senses.exampleCN: 该政权以必胜的豪言回应制裁。
senses.why: Puffed cloth and puffed threats are the same gesture.
senses.whyCN: 撑起的衣料与撑起的威胁是同一种姿态。

senses.title: Pompous style in writing
senses.definition: writing swollen with weighty words and thin substance
senses.definitionCN: 辞藻沉重而内容单薄的文风
senses.example: The report buried one page of fact in forty of bombast.
senses.exampleCN: 这份报告用四十页空话埋掉了一页事实。
senses.why: Padding a text is padding a coat, word by word.
senses.whyCN: 给文章填料，与给外衣填料无异，一字一字地撑。

senses.title: Insincere emotional display
senses.definition: showy display of feeling without real commitment
senses.definitionCN: 没有真实投入的炫示性情感表露
senses.example: His grief was bombast, gone by dinner.
senses.exampleCN: 他的悲痛是表演，饭前就散了。
senses.why: Feeling, too, can be stuffed to look larger than it is.
senses.whyCN: 情感也能被填料撑大，显得超出其本相。

senses.title: The old stuffing material itself
senses.definition: cotton or wadding used to pad and stiffen clothes
senses.definitionCN: 用于垫衬和定形的棉花填料
senses.example: Tailors sewed bombast into the doublet's shoulders.
senses.exampleCN: 裁缝往紧身上衣的肩部缝入棉絮衬垫。
senses.why: The literal cloth sense is the word's starting point.
senses.whyCN: 字面的布料义正是该词的起点。

senses.title: Puffed-up personal manner
senses.definition: an inflated personal style of talking and behaving
senses.definitionCN: 言谈举止间自我膨胀的做派
senses.example: Underneath the bombast, he doubted every word he said.
senses.exampleCN: 在那副夸夸其谈之下，他对自己说的每个字都心存怀疑。
senses.why: Padding hides a thin frame; manner can be worn like cloth.
senses.whyCN: 填料遮住单薄的骨架，做派亦可如布料般穿戴。

senses.title: Advertising and sales hype
senses.definitionCN: 没有实质内容的夸张宣传之词
senses.example: Cut through the bombast and compare actual prices.
senses.exampleCN: 抛开那些吹嘘，直接比较实际价格。
senses.why: Ads pad their products as tailors once padded sleeves.
senses.whyCN: 广告为产品填料，正如昔日裁缝为衣袖填料。

intro.en: Bombast began as a word for cotton padding, from Latin bombax, cotton.
intro.cn: bombast 本指填充棉絮，源自拉丁语 bombax「棉花」。

items.en: a root of swelling and bursting, shared with bomb.
items.cn: 印欧词根表「膨胀、爆裂」，与 bomb 同源。
希腊语 bambax／bombax 意为「棉花」。

items.en: bombax and bombacium named cotton wool and padding.
items.cn: 中世纪拉丁语 bombax、bombacium 指棉絮与填料。

items.en: English bombast first meant quilted padding for clothes.
items.cn: 英语 bombast（16 世纪）先指衣物的衬垫棉絮。

items.en: metaphor transferred the padding to inflated speech, and the cloth sense died out.
items.cn: 17 世纪前后隐喻转指「浮夸言辞」，布料本义随即消亡。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the bomb- sound; the near-meaning group gathers inflated-speech words.
note.cn: 形近组共享 bomb- 音；近义组收浮夸言辞类词。

normalIntro.en: Bombast was once coat padding, now it is speech padding.
normalIntro.cn: bombast 曾是衣料填料，今指言辞填料。

normal.en: It has nothing to do with bombs.
Politicians and actors are its usual subjects.
normal.cn: 它常用于政治人物与演员。

normal.en: Hot air is its casual twin.
normal.cn: 口语中 hot air 是它的随和双胞胎。

abstract.en: See a suit stuffed so wide the man disappears.
abstract.cn: 看一套撑得过宽、把人都吞没的西装。

abstract.en: Hear thunder without a single drop of rain.
abstract.cn: 听只有雷声没有一滴雨的天。

abstract.en: Feel a balloon word burst into nothing.
abstract.cn: 感受一个气球般的词炸成了空无。

examples.en: The speech was pure bombast with no plan at all.
examples.cn: 这篇讲话全是空话，毫无计划可言。

examples.en: The regime answered sanctions with bombast about victory.
examples.cn: 该政权以必胜的豪言回应制裁。

examples.en: Cut through the bombast and compare actual prices.
examples.cn: 抛开那些吹嘘，直接比较实际价格。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「棒 boosting」——把自己「棒 boosting」到天上去的言辞，全是浮夸大话。

root: 拉丁语 bombax「棉花」（希腊语 bambax，印欧词根表「膨胀」，与 bomb 同源），经中世纪拉丁语 bombacium 与法语，16 世纪英语 bombast 本指衣物衬垫棉絮，后隐喻转指「膨胀空洞的言辞」，本义消亡。

sensesIntro.en: From wadding sewn into doublets to rhetoric sewn into speeches, bombast always means padding.
sensesIntro.cn: 从缝进紧身上衣的棉絮到缝进演讲的修辞，bombast 永远指「填料」。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a suit padded so wide the man vanishes
core.cn: 核心意象：被填料撑得过宽、吞没人形的西装

branches.en: Empty language in speech and print

intro.en: Bombast is a lone noun whose adjective took over the family.
intro.cn: bombast 是孤立的名词，其形容词撑起了词族。

items.structure: Latin grandis plus loqui, near meaning
